title: user.registered
description: Emitted by the Auth Service when a new user identity is successfully registered. Consumed by the User Service to provision the User aggregate idempotently keyed on `external_auth_id` (the OAuth/OIDC `sub` claim). Topic: user.registered. Partition key: user_id. Subject in Schema Registry: user.registered-value. Required fields are enforced; `additionalProperties` is false (the closed-world contract). Optional auth-issuer metadata fields (auth_provider, auth_issuer, auth_audience, email_verified, display_name, first_name, last_name, locale) MAY be supplied by the producer and are used by the User Service to seed initial profile and preference rows. Satisfies AAP R-14 (Schema Registry validated), R-23 (OAuth 2.0 / RFC 6749 conformant claims), R-30 (topic name mirrors event name), R-31 (version field for backward-compatible evolution), R-32 (producer does not enumerate consumers), R-33 (event is self-contained — User Service does NOT call back to Auth Service to interpret the event).

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance. Used by the User Service as the idempotency key when processing the message.

version.description: Event payload schema version per AAP R-31. Incremented when the schema evolves backward-compatibly. Consumers MUST tolerate values they do not yet know about.

user_id.description: User aggregate identifier (UUID v4 or v7) assigned by the Auth Service on first registration. Used by the User Service as the primary key of the `users.users` table and as the partition key for all `user.*` Kafka events.

external_auth_id.description: Stable identifier from the auth issuer's `sub` (subject) claim per RFC 6749 / RFC 6750. UNIQUE upsert key for `users.external_auth_id`; enables idempotent provisioning so that re-delivered `user.registered` events do not create duplicate user rows.

email.description: User's primary email address at registration. Lowercase, RFC-5321/5322 validated. UNIQUE in `users.users.email`.

registered_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC, with offset suffix) at which registration was completed at the auth issuer.

auth_provider.description: Optional. Authentication provider identifier (e.g., `password`, `google`, `github`, `okta`, `apple`). Used for analytics and to drive provider-specific onboarding flows.

auth_issuer.description: Optional. OIDC `iss` claim — the issuer URL identifying the authority that authenticated the user (e.g., `https://example.auth0.com/`).

auth_audience.description: Optional. OIDC `aud` claim associated with the registration.

email_verified.description: Optional. Whether the email address was verified at the auth issuer at the time of registration. Drives downstream gating (e.g., transactional emails may be deferred until verification).

display_name.description: Optional. Display name from the OIDC `name` claim, when available. Seeds `user_profiles.display_name`.

first_name.description: Optional. From the OIDC `given_name` claim, when available. Seeds `user_profiles.first_name`.

last_name.description: Optional. From the OIDC `family_name` claim, when available. Seeds `user_profiles.last_name`.

locale.description: Optional. BCP-47 locale tag from the auth provider's `locale` claim (e.g., `en-US`, `fr-FR`, `zh-Hant-TW`). Seeds `user_preferences.preferred_language`.
